profiles.description: Administers business-critical IT systems across ABC Insurance's operating platforms, owning identity and access provisioning — system access, email, and security badges for new hires, plus role-based provisioning and deprovisioning of HR systems — and configuration of HRIS business-process workflows. Monitors and supports scheduled batch cycles across policy administration, participating in runs such as annual policy statement production, Death Master File matching, interest crediting recalculations, and automatic subaccount rebalancing. Also validates CI relationships and service-dependency mappings in the CMDB and coordinates production readiness for releases affecting operations teams. The role leads within the Human Resources Talent value stream (HR technology administration) while supporting Business Operations and Technology Engineering, and executes periodic access recertification and segregation-of-duties reviews.

Network & Computer Systems Administrators at My Next Move

Priors (Engineering / IC) confirmed by research.

profiles.description: Runs end-to-end recruiting for the carrier within the Human Resources Talent value stream: drafts job descriptions and competency requirements, builds channel-specific sourcing plans, and engages passive candidate pipelines. Owns the structured interview process (distributing interview guides and scorecards), employer branding (career site, employer review profiles, campus and career-fair events), pre-employment screening clearance verification and I-9 compliance documentation, and alumni re-engagement outreach. Participates in workforce demand planning by collecting business-unit hiring forecasts and quantifying supply-versus-demand gaps by critical skill family. Tracks funnel metrics, offer approvals, and hiring risks via a hiring pipeline dashboard.

profiles.description: Prepares and supports the insurance-specific tax workload at the carrier: federal and state income tax provisions under ASC 740 for GAAP and statutory reporting, deferred tax asset admissibility under SSAP 101, premium tax and guaranty fund returns, and quarterly estimated payments reconciled to the general ledger. On the product side, the role owns policyholder tax events — recording 1035 exchange tax attributes and confirming nontaxable treatment and basis carryover, applying tax withholding and 1099-R basis on withdrawals and surrenders, and calculating and processing annuity RMD payments with withholding. Participates in producer TIN validation, intercompany transfer pricing charges, escheatment dormancy identification, and book-to-tax difference scheduling. Supports federal return preparation, tax authority audits, and notice resolution.

profiles.description: Owns tax strategy, filings, governance, and tax risk management for the carrier across jurisdictions, leading within the Finance Investments and Finance, Treasury & Capital Management value streams. Reviews and approves income tax returns prior to filing, oversees dividend payments to the parent holding company, and participates in state premium tax and retaliatory tax calculation and OPTins filings as well as tax audit and controversy management (notice logging, IDR responses, exposure quantification). Approves or recommends policy changes, exceptions, and action plans related to tax, and coordinates with finance, legal, treasury, controllership, external advisors, and regulators. The packet also assigns ownership of procurement governance steps — award recommendations, purchase order conversion, and contract commitment encumbrances in the ledger.

classificationFlags.item: Document Award Recommendation And Obtain Governance Approval
classificationFlags.rationale: Sourcing award recommendations belong to procurement/sourcing per standard Tax Director scopes in both fetched job descriptions, which never mention sourcing or bidding.

Notable packet tension: the Tax Director is only Participant on tax audit/controversy tasks that the Treasury Manager packet shows as Owner — research suggests this ownership is inverted (flagged on the Treasury Manager profile). Procurement deliverables (Sourcing & Competitive Bidding, Purchase Order & Procurement Governance) look misattached to this role.

profiles.description: Manages the carrier's day-to-day tax function beneath the Tax Director: computing current and deferred tax, preparing the tax provision and premium tax filings, filing income tax returns, managing tax authority audits, and reconciling tax accounts and disclosures. Insurance-carrier tax managers of this profile administer federal, state, and local income and franchise tax returns, extensions, and estimated payments, and oversee tax-related projects, information requests, and process improvements. The role is a supervisory position in corporate taxation, typically reviewing the work of tax analysts and coordinating with external auditors and tax authorities.

sources.title: Tax Manager Job Details | Erie Insurance
Tax Manager Career Overview (Accounting.com)

proposedOrgUnit.rationale: The packet's responsibilities (tax provision, premium tax filings, returns, audits) mirror the Tax Analyst and Tax Director roles that both home in Finance & Investments / Treasury & Tax.

Priors said roleFamily Specialist / roleLevel Individual Contributor; research disagrees on both — the Erie Insurance carrier posting shows a management-level role that hires, trains, and directs personnel, and Accounting.com confirms supervisory scope. Prefer Finance / Manager.

profiles.description: Leads engineering delivery squads within the Technology Engineering value stream: signs off solution designs and hands them to engineering for build, conducts peer code reviews on pull requests, merges approved code to mainline and tags builds, and validates API designs against the enterprise REST style guide. Owns technical documentation version control, engineering knowledge management (lessons learned from completed deliveries), and peer review of integration code against build standards. Participates in agile ceremonies — story-point estimation, sprint capacity commitment, and retrospectives — and maintains ADRs, working agreements, Definition of Ready/Done, and squad capacity planning across sprints. Supports Product Delivery and technology change/architecture value streams alongside the lead role.

profiles.description: Plans and coordinates technology delivery at the carrier from the Program Governance department: builds integrated project plans across business, IT, and vendor workstreams, maintains RAID logs and drives risks, issues, and dependencies to resolution, and tracks budget, variances, and change requests through governance. Participates heavily in release and cutover activity — mapping cross-team release dependencies, scheduling release windows on the enterprise release calendar, building business readiness checklists and cutover task lists, confirming hypercare staffing, and confirming operational readiness across servicing, claims, and call-center teams for go-live. Also supports agile delivery framework standards (Azure Boards configuration, squad onboarding to tooling) and manages vendor deliverables and SOW milestones against contract terms.

profiles.description: Owns producer and agency distribution for an assigned territory within the Sales Distribution Marketing value stream. Draws balanced sales territory boundaries and assigns producers and accounts to territories in CRM, then owns the full producer lifecycle: welcome and systems orientation, role-based training curricula, product and underwriting appetite training, early-life production targets and ramp plans, 30/60/90-day check-ins, and early submission quality and appetite-alignment reviews. Verifies producer licensing and appetite for qualified leads, trains producers and sales users on CRM and lead tools, and carries deliverables spanning channel performance analytics, producer scorecards, and producer termination and off-boarding governance. Recruits and appoints new agencies and represents the carrier at industry events.

profiles.description: Owns testing and quality assurance across Product Delivery and Technology Engineering value streams: authors test cases and business acceptance scenarios from acceptance criteria, executes integration and system test cycles, builds and integrates the automated regression suite, and triages and tracks defects to resolution. Coordinates business acceptance testing end to end — scheduling business tester execution sessions, triaging UAT defects with severity and reproduction steps, and capturing business sign-off on acceptance results — and produces the QA sign-off and exit criteria report gating releases. Deliverables extend to integration testing and certification, release readiness assessment, and test environment strategy and lifecycle management, with a documented master test strategy, risk-based testing approach, and compliance/audit evidence mapping (SOX and similar).

profiles.description: Owns the third-party risk management framework at the carrier, leading the Third-Party & Vendor Management and Risk Compliance Audit value streams. Runs the TPRM lifecycle end to end: captures intake requests and inherent risk profiles, tiers vendors by criticality and data sensitivity, issues and collects due diligence assessments by risk domain, assesses findings to set residual risk and approval conditions, and records onboarding decisions with monitoring cadences through to exit management. Owns operational-resilience service mapping — tracing third-party and intragroup dependencies for each important business service — and participates in setting impact tolerances, quarterly vendor service reviews, and escalation of persistent vendor performance failures. Deliverables also cover anti-bribery & corruption controls and vendor privacy and data processing governance.

profiles.description: Executes portfolio trades for the carrier's general account within the Finance Investments value stream, working per portfolio manager direction and the investment policy statement. Routes approved orders to brokers and captures execution fills, generates and confirms trade allocations and settlement instructions with investment operations and the custodian, and builds rebalancing trade lists to return portfolios to target weights. Recommends duration-matching trades or hedges to close asset-liability gaps identified by ALM. Monitors markets and liquidity conditions and maintains broker-dealer relationships.

profiles.description: Coordinates training logistics and completion tracking across the carrier's business units from the Learning & Change department, supporting the HR, Actuarial, PMO, and Risk Compliance Audit value streams. Schedules new hires into orientation sessions and onboarding curricula, assigns and tracks mandatory compliance training — including annual AML training for in-scope staff and producers and anti-bribery & corruption completion certification for high-risk staff — and tracks actuarial continuing-education and qualification credits. Administers the learning management system, course catalog, and completion records; coordinates rooms, materials, facilitators, and virtual classroom setup; and collects post-session evaluations for instructional designers and course owners. Communicates training calendars, prerequisites, and enrollment instructions and follows up with overdue learners.

profiles.description: Designs and builds learning content for the carrier from the Learning & Change department, leading within the Human Resources Talent value stream. Owns learning needs analysis and curriculum design — mapping learning objectives to job roles and designing curriculum structures and learning pathways — and content development: authoring e-learning storyboards and scripts, building SCORM course packages in authoring tools, and curating vendor and open-source content into the catalog. Owns training knowledge management, capturing subject-matter expertise into knowledge articles and organizing the knowledge taxonomy and search tagging. Develops scenario-based content for policy administration, claims, and annuity servicing systems, pilots new courses with learner feedback before rollout, builds assessments that validate proficiency, and participates in succession-readiness development planning and new-hire orientation delivery.

profiles.description: Executes daily treasury operations for the carrier's insurance legal entities within the Finance Investments value stream. Owns the daily cash position end to end — importing overnight bank balances, reconciling the opening position, projecting inflows and outflows, determining net daily surplus or shortfall by entity, and tracking forecast accuracy. Owns payment execution with sanctions screening (transmitting payment files, confirming acknowledgments, investigating returned or failed payments), bank account management and connectivity (opening/closing accounts, testing statement feeds, reconciling bank fees against negotiated agreements), and liquidity aggregation across entities and accounts. Funds claims, reinsurance, and operating disbursement accounts, executes wires and intercompany settlements under dual approval, and monitors letters of credit and collateral supporting reinsurance and large-deductible programs.

profiles.description: Manages liquidity planning, cash positioning, and treasury governance for the carrier, leading the Finance Investments, Finance, Treasury & Capital Management, and FinOps/Cloud Financial Management value streams. Owns the control layer of treasury operations: recommending short-term investment or borrowing actions to cover the daily position, applying dual-authorization release controls to payment runs, maintaining authorized signatories and bank mandates, allocating excess liquidity to approved short-term instruments, and overseeing liquidity stress testing and funding, debt, and intercompany financing deliverables. Reviews KPIs, risks, and audit items and approves or recommends policy changes and exceptions, coordinating with finance, investments, tax, risk, accounting, and banking partners. The packet additionally assigns ownership of fixed asset capitalization, tax audit and controversy management, and tax planning and structuring tasks.
